context: Riku-teen visits a small shrine alone for new year prayer; Asuka happens by.
purpose: Teacher running into student at quiet spiritual moment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Riku — did you come for first visit of the year?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested. Soft opening. The casual familiarity of a teacher noticing a student outside school. Not prying, just welcoming.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい、新年の祈り、しに来ました。
lines.style: Quiet, earnest. A small breath before answering. Respectful but natural — not performed politeness. Looking slightly upward, grounded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Gentle follow-up. Leans in slightly with real attention. The kind of listening that makes a student feel safe telling the truth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Brief, honest. A small pause before the word 「合格」— letting the weight of it sit for a moment. Vulnerable but steady.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 叶うわよ、努力してるから。
lines.en: It will. You're putting in the work.
lines.style: Firm certainty wrapped in warmth. Not flattery — a teacher stating what she observes as fact. Steady eye contact. The reassurance that lands because it's earned.
